title: Mixed Event — The BEST Summer Ever!

meta.Outline: The Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy first years arrive at the Seaside School. Finding themselves allocated to the same group for the school's annual presentation event, Honami, Saki, Emu, and Kohane put their showmanship skills to the test by performing a song from a musical.

rows.Line: Beach

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay, the beach!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's so beautiful...!
The waves are sparkling with sunlight and there's such a nice breeze too...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hnnnng!
Wonderhoy!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We get to spend three whole days here!
It's gonna be so much fun☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's have as much fun as we can!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I hope you two haven't forgotten that this is the Seaside School. You'll only have so much free time...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But, what do you actually do at Seaside School?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I remember that we get to do some really fun stuff, like doing group presentations or performances☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I believe we're supposed to be split into groups of four and present something at the end together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: While we're here, we'll be practicing and showing everyone what we've come up with on the final day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, that sounds like a ton of fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And we're allowed to present anything?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I think we are. As far as I know, anything from a song to a skit will do as long as your whole group participates.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Even better!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What should we do?
I wanna do something that goes all sparkle-sparkle-boom-boom♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sparkle-sparkle-boom-boom?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can't say for sure, but that sounds very ambitious.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, aren't we supposed to be a group of four? We're still missing one...

Um, excuse me...!
Sorry for being late...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Kohane!!
Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-Wonderhoy...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Uh... Thank you, Otori.
I'm happy that we're in the same group.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You're Azusawa, yes?
My name is Honami Mochizuki.
It's nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm Saki Tenma!
We're glad you're finally here, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay, Mochizuki and Tenma...
Thank you for having me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um... Shiho and Ichika have already told me a little about you, Mochizuki, Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You don't have to act so formal around us! You can just call me by my first name♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too. Would it also be okay if we call you Kohane as well?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...!
Th-Thank you...
Honami, Saki and Emu.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I didn't know that you'd already met Kohane beforehand, Emu. I wasn't expecting that since we're in different classes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, when did that happen? Were you two already friends from before?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, we actually met and started talking to each other fairly recently...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heh heh heh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We met for the first time at Phoenix Wonderland☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes...!
I just absolutely love Phoenix Wonderland and used to go there pretty often.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I even got to see Emu and her troupe perform on stage and really loved that as well...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Kohane's our Number One Fan because she was there to see us perform as Wonderlands×Showtime for the very first time!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, that's so cool! Your very first fan goes to the same school as you...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Your number one fan...
Thank you. I feel so honored.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So does that mean you know about my brother too, Kohane...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?
Your brother...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa Tenma. He performs with Emu as a member of Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I didn't realize that...!
Does that mean you know Aoyagi too?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Aoyagi... You mean Toya?
Yeah, we've known each other since we were both really little.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
This so amazing...!
Aoyagi always speaks so highly of your brother, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, do you mean Tsukasa's friend that came to our Doll Festival party? We live in such a small world, don't we...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup☆
Our other friends were already friends with each other. It's such a crazy coincidence♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But how is it that you know about him? You and him go to different schools, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I actually sing with him as part of a team.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There's four of us in total, and I've been performing at events and shows with them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?! You and Toya? Singing together?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I didn't know that you've been performing at events. That's so great...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe... I'm starting to blush...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Ladies, it's almost time for swim practice...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, already?
We need to get changed.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I can't wait☆
Hey, let's have a race once we get in the water♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, I'm not much of a swimmer, but it would be nice if we could do it together...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Saki, is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
S-Sorry!
It's just, I'm a little scared of swimming in the ocean...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You didn't get to go in the pool much even during junior high.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I was in the hospital for a little while during junior high.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I am honestly a little afraid of swimming in the ocean, but I wanna be able to swim with all of you...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You'll be fine☆
I'm sure you'll figure it out!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and I'll be there to teach you! I took swimming lessons for a while, so I should be able to help you some...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
Thanks, Hona...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Would you like it if I helped you as well, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course! We can all try together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, looks like we're all changed. Shall we begin practice?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. This is gonna be so much fun!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Eep! The waves are so big!
I... I don't think I can do this...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Are you okay...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If only we had a kickboard or an inner tube, then this wouldn't be nearly as scary...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! I brought some just in case!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I was hoping that they'd come in handy when we did get to go swimming. I have two, so I'll let you borrow one☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
Lemme go get them. Be right back!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mr. Inner Tube, where are you? It should be in my bag... Oh, here we go!
<Emuuu!!!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yay! Summer vacation♪
How's the Seaside School been so far?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Miku!
Welcome♪ We're actually just about to go swimming!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Really? I wish I could go with you!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Than how about this?
We can have fun some later when I get a break!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yay!!
I'm looking forward to it, Emu☆>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I can't wait either, Miku♪ Let's make the Seaside School as wonderhoy as it can be!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Saki, here you go!
One Mr. Inner Tube!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Emu, thank you so much♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I won't let this go to waste! I'll do my best to get over my fears and learn how to swim!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Then, shall we get started...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, Saki, grab onto both of my hands and try to stretch your legs out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Uhh... Like this?
How does this look, Hona?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, very good!
You're doing great, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Now, try gently kicking with your legs. You too, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay...!
Gently kick... Like this?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Lemme try too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Kick with my legs like... Oh, I think I got it! I'm swimming! I'm really swimming!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, you're both doing super awesome☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're doing incredibly well. At this rate, you won't need me to hold on to you next time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay!! Thanks for doing this, Hona. And thank you for lending me your inner tube, Emu♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone!
They said they're going to be smashing watermelon after swimming practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Apparently, it's class versus class.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We get to smash watermelons?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That sounds like way too much fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've never done that before... Is it hard?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, you should be able to enjoy it even if it's your first time. We can both try together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: R-Right. Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, let's go!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Hehe. It looks like this is going to be quite a memorable summer.)
Beach

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Miku, thanks for waiting!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sorry, we ended up having this watermelon-smashing competition and had to help clean everything up.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That's totally okay☆>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, Emu! Since we're at the beach, I wanna bring gifts back for KAITO and the others. What do you think would be good?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Gifts...? What about some big seashells or a bunch of really pretty ones...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: When I was with everyone else just now, I saw some pink ones that looked so cute. MEIKO and the other girls might really like those!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That'd be perfect! I wanna see those too! I could even find a whole lot of them and turn them into a necklace!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's try looking them☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Captain Miku, have you spotted any good shells?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <No, not yet... Private Emu, have you had better luck...?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I found a lot of pretty ones but nothing really big...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line: Emu, we're about to start making curry. Would you mind helping us?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, right... Be right there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sorry, Miku...!
I'll help you find more tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <No, this was fun. I'm glad we got to look for shells like this together♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'll see you later.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It's too bad that we couldn't find a big shell... I wonder if I'll have some time after we're done making the curry...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I might be able to find one if I check somewhere I haven't explored yet...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Honami, that curry we made was so good! It tasted so wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you liked it. You prepping all those vegetables for us was a big help too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And we'll be discussing what we'll be presenting after this, right? It's a little early, but would you like to head back to our room?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, there's something I need to do first. You can go on ahead without me, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? What could that be?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Well, I'm hoping to find a really big seashell and give it to everyone at the Wonder Stage as a gift.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A seashell?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! They can't be here since they go to a different school, so I want to bring back something from here that they can enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
That's so nice of you to share your enjoyment with your friends, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Actually, I already found a lot of pretty shells, but I'm still looking for a really big one... There's one place I haven't checked yet, so I wanna see if I can find one there!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A really big shell...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. We still have time until we have to meet with the others, so why don't we help you look for one in the meantime...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really? You will?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Of course.
I'm sure we'll have better luck if we work together.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks, Honami...!
Lodge Gym

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sorry I'm late... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (There's no one here... Did I get here too soon?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Unless... Am I in the wrong place?! Oh no, what do I do...?!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Kohane, there you are!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Saki...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank goodness. That means I'm in the right place. I was worried that it wasn't for a second there...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha♪
That's so cute, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, also, this lodge is cleaner than I expected and it kinda has a school feel to it, doesn’t it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree...
I think the handbook we all got even mentioned how the teachers come here for training sessions.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It may be designed to feel like an actual school. I even saw a music room just now on my way over here...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You did? I wonder if they have any instruments lying around. It'd be fun to play some if we have the time to...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You're the keyboardist for your band, right? I'd like to hear you play sometime.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, for sure!
I'll ask a teacher later and see if there is anything we can play.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh,  that reminds me...
I haven't heard you sing yet either, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! You said that you sing with Toya, so I really wanna hear what your singing voice is like!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Uh, well...
Our team's comprised of me, Aoyagi and two more. The others are a boy and a girl that are around our age.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're called Vivid BAD SQUAD.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Our goal is to put on an event that surpasses this legendary event called RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. I wasn't actually there to see it, but it was an event that featured artists and performers of all sorts of different genres.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We know that we have a tough road ahead if we are going to achieve that goal, but we're working hard every day to make our dream come true...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, that's so cool!
Trying to surpass a legendary event sounds like you guys are really making the most of your youth!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I-It does...?
I don't know if we really are, but things have been really fun since we formed our team.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But you're in a band with Ichika, aren't you, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup♪
We trying to go pro together! Oh, but Shiho's always so mean to us during practice...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Your dream sounds wonderful too, Saki.
se_event_summer_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Made it!!
Oh, Saki and Kohane are already here...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I can see that.
I hope we didn't keep you two waiting.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, we really just got here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, she got here right after I did and we were having a quick chat.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hm? Emu, is that a seashell...?
It's beautiful... And so big.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup! I was helping Mi...
Uh, I spent so much time looking really hard for one, but wasn't having any luck...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I helped out a little bit... But I'm glad you were able to find one in the end, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna look for seashells too. Maybe I'll go looking for some later when I have some time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'd like to do that too...!
It'd be nice to find one for An.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, let's look for some together! I found a really good spot just now too♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay!! That's a promise, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we begin discussing what we'll be presenting?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A presentation, huh? I'm not sure if I'm getting nervous or excited. What do you think everyone else is gonna do?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There's no set theme that we have to stick to, but it sounded like most groups usually just go with something beach or ocean-themed...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We also have seven minutes to work with. We won't be able to do anything too extravagant, but anything goes as long as we're all in it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Since we all have to be in it, shouldn't we do something that we're all sort of good at?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Something we're all good at...?
Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Why don't we put on a musical? You're really good at singing, right, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, I can sing, but I've never done any acting before...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, what if we did one song from a musical and played something to go along with it...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona and I can be on instrument duty. Emu and Kohane, you two can be our singers.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, that sounds like fun!!
What do you think, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, as long as I'm just singing, I should be fine...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd like to give it a try as well. Oh, but are there any instruments that we can use here...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We should ask the teachers just to check, but I'm pretty certain that there are. I just passed by a music room on my way over here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
Even without a drum kit, we should be able to figure something out.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then let's go with that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we should probably pick something that we all know.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. We won't have much time to practice, so something we already know would move everything along much quicker...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, how about this one!
Hum-humm♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm... I want to say that I've heard it before...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, I know that song!
It's from that musical, right?!
Happy Lucky Summer!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's from the part when the female leads all make up in the end!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! That's it, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I think I've seen it before.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's about this really headstrong girl, Dorothy, who lives in this port city, and this other girl, Amy, who just moved into town, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! My brother loves that one and I even got to see it with him♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Dorothy becomes friends with Amy, but they end up getting into a fight...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The song Emu just hummed is from the scene where they apologize to each other and make up!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, isn't it called BEST SUMMER...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've never seen this musical, but I think I heard that song in a commercial once on TV.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
W-W-W-W-Wonderhoy!
Let's pick this song then☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Especially since we already seem to know it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That reminds me... What everybody presents will also be voted on by the teachers and students on the planning committee. It'd be nice to do well if we're going to be competing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I forgot about that. The top three get some kind of prize, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A prize?! Really?! What can we get?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
An invitation to a cafe.
I think they said, Le Lion.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! We get to go to Le Lion if we do well?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is it famous, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. It's one of those cafes where it's impossible to get a reservation. I saw it in a magazine once and have been dying to go ever since.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's apparently gorgeous and really classy on the inside, but they also have parfaits, tarts and other desserts that are topped with a mountain of fruits...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then let's win it all and check out this cafe together♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Do you really think we can win...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sure we can.
We should as long as we give it everything we have, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Even if we don't win, there's still silver and bronze.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Maybe we can if you and Emu say so, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then let's do everything we can and go for the gold!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
Lodge Gym

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, is this a good spot for our instruments?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup. Drum on the left and the keyboard on the right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But who would've known that this place had a keyboard and a drum kit!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it's a little old, but they seem like more than enough for us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I'll go grab some chairs and desks from one of the other classrooms. They might be nice to have while we're practicing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll help you get them!
Lodge Classroom

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hey, Emu. What are you up to right now?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're practicing for our presentation. My group decided to do a musical.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, that sounds like fun♪
Mind if I watch you practice?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course.
I'd love it if you could see us perform!

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Voice
rows.Line: Emu, can you lend me a hand with this...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
